description: Header file defining the SimpleBackendImpl class for a disk cache backend in Chromium, including class declarations, member functions, and related data structures.

classes.name: SimpleBackendImpl
classes.description: A class implementing a simple disk cache backend storing entries in individual files, with methods for managing cache entries, size, and iteration.

methods.name: SimpleBackendImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache backend with configuration parameters.

methods.name: ~SimpleBackendImpl
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Returns the associated SimpleIndex object.

methods.name: SetTaskRunnerForTesting
methods.description: Sets a custom task runner for testing purposes.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Asynchronously finishes initialization.

methods.name: SetMaxSize
methods.description: Sets the maximum total size of cache data.

methods.name: MaxFileSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum file size permitted.

methods.name: OnDoomStart
methods.description: Marks an entry as being doomed, preventing new operations until completion.

methods.name: DoomEntries
methods.description: Dooms multiple entries by their hashes.

methods.name: GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the number of entries.

methods.name: OpenEntry
methods.description: Opens a cache entry by key.

methods.name: CreateEntry
methods.description: Creates a new cache entry.

methods.name: OpenOrCreateEntry
methods.description: Opens or creates a cache entry.

methods.name: DoomEntry
methods.description: Dooms a cache entry by key.

methods.name: DoomAllEntries
methods.description: Dooms all cache entries.

methods.name: DoomEntriesBetween
methods.description: Dooms entries between two times.

methods.name: DoomEntriesSince
methods.description: Dooms entries since a specific time.

methods.name: CalculateSizeOfAllEntries
methods.description: Calculates total size of all entries.

methods.name: CalculateSizeOfEntriesBetween
methods.description: Calculates size of entries between two times.

methods.name: CreateIterator
methods.description: Creates an iterator over cache entries.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves cache statistics.

methods.name: OnExternalCacheHit
methods.description: Handles external cache hit for a key.

methods.name: GetEntryInMemoryData
methods.description: Gets in-memory data associated with a key.

methods.name: SetEntryInMemoryData
methods.description: Sets in-memory data for a key.
